loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

requirements.text: Decision rows must expose current project state, explicit decision/change delta, expected final state, and validated final state; underspecified deltas block decision gate pass.
Target source structure keeps exactly three loop roots owning compiler and gate behavior: src/decision, src/planning, and src/implementation; publication remains under implementation.
Decision compiler/gate must normalize accepted evidence to row-level Decision Table semantics and require plannable row/requirement atomicity.
Planning compiler/gate must require structured decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation; prose-only coverage cannot pass semantic/system planning.
Accepted target file-structure deltas must have implementation evidence, active roadmap/sprint coverage, or structured deferral with owner/trigger/evidence.
Planning gate must enforce atomic task boundaries and avoid auto-reuse/merge unless requirement ids and desired outcomes overlap.
Planning trace must include execution graph metadata: work units, dependencies, waves, conflict scopes, lease plan, route-back triggers, roles, required gates, and publisher serialization.

Agency authorizes parallel continuation, runtime daemon dispatches workers through freshWorkerBridge, implementation workers execute roles, gates validate outputs, and publisher serializes merge/final graph/content evidence.
Tests are evidence providers; loop-owned gates define required test/linters/content proof and implementation traces record test refs/results.
After gate/planning repair planning, create a refactor sprint for remaining target roots and stale/deprecated cleanup in atomic safe waves.

decision_table.title: Accepted decision/planning/gate/runtime repair decisions after source-structure mental-model recovery.

rows.question: DPA-000-DECISION-DELTA-SCHEMA

state_delta.current: Decision rows can blur desired state, agreed decision, expected final state, and validated final state, making deltas underspecified.
state_delta.desired: Decision rows use strict state-delta contract: current state, explicit change delta, expected final state, and later validated final state; decision gate blocks underspecified deltas.

rows.proposed_change: Decision rows use strict state-delta contract: current state, explicit change delta, expected final state, and later validated final state; decision gate blocks underspecified deltas.
rows.rationale: Planning quality depends on exact delta size, risk, partial coverage, and residual work.
rows.expected_outcome: Decision rows use strict state-delta contract: current state, explicit change delta, expected final state, and later validated final state; decision gate blocks underspecified deltas.

rows.question: DPA-001-LOOP-OWNED-GATES

state_delta.current: Gateway behavior lives in compatibility roots and could be mistaken as permanent central source root.
state_delta.desired: Exactly three loop roots own compilers and gates: src/decision, src/planning, src/implementation; gateway/policy/checks/validation are compatibility/helper migration surfaces.

rows.proposed_change: Exactly three loop roots own compilers and gates: src/decision, src/planning, src/implementation; gateway/policy/checks/validation are compatibility/helper migration surfaces.
rows.rationale: Matches accepted three-loop file-structure mental model; no fourth validation/gateway root.
rows.expected_outcome: Exactly three loop roots own compilers and gates: src/decision, src/planning, src/implementation; gateway/policy/checks/validation are compatibility/helper migration surfaces.

rows.question: DPA-002-DECISION-ROW-ATOMICITY

state_delta.current: Broad decision rows can map to one narrow task and look complete.
state_delta.desired: Decision compiler/gate require approved rows or derived requirement ids to be plannable; broad desired states decompose before decision gate pass or carry phased residual obligations.

rows.proposed_change: Decision compiler/gate require approved rows or derived requirement ids to be plannable; broad desired states decompose before decision gate pass or carry phased residual obligations.
rows.rationale: DTP-005 mapped full source restructure to TASK-109 although TASK-109 covered only one slice.
rows.expected_outcome: Decision compiler/gate require approved rows or derived requirement ids to be plannable; broad desired states decompose before decision gate pass or carry phased residual obligations.

rows.question: DPA-003-ROW-LEVEL-TRACE-NORMALIZATION

state_delta.current: Evidence mixes legacy diff_table, approved_rows, decision_table, and build/table-level fields; row-level trace coverage is not universal.
state_delta.desired: Decision compiler/gate normalize accepted evidence to row-level Decision Table semantics, including legacy diff_table/approved_rows compatibility, before planning consumes it.

rows.proposed_change: Decision compiler/gate normalize accepted evidence to row-level Decision Table semantics, including legacy diff_table/approved_rows compatibility, before planning consumes it.
rows.rationale: Audit found 44 legacy diff_table builds and 9 decision_table builds; coverage must be row/requirement-level.
rows.expected_outcome: Decision compiler/gate normalize accepted evidence to row-level Decision Table semantics, including legacy diff_table/approved_rows compatibility, before planning consumes it.

rows.question: DPA-004-STRUCTURED-PLANNING-COVERAGE

state_delta.current: Decision-sourced planning builds can pass with prose and no structured decision_coverage or roadmap_reconciliation arrays.
state_delta.desired: Planning compiler emits structured decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation; planning gate rejects prose-only coverage for semantic/system work.

rows.proposed_change: Planning compiler emits structured decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation; planning gate rejects prose-only coverage for semantic/system work.
rows.rationale: Audit found 61 decision-sourced planning builds and 0 structured coverage arrays.
rows.expected_outcome: Planning compiler emits structured decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation; planning gate rejects prose-only coverage for semantic/system work.

rows.question: DPA-005-PARTIAL-COVERAGE-RESIDUALS

state_delta.current: A row mapped to any task can be treated as resolved even when task covers only part of desired state.
state_delta.desired: Planning/graph distinguish full, partial, implemented, active-roadmap, deferred, no-work, superseded, replanned, and unmapped states; partial coverage leaves blocking residuals.

rows.proposed_change: Planning/graph distinguish full, partial, implemented, active-roadmap, deferred, no-work, superseded, replanned, and unmapped states; partial coverage leaves blocking residuals.
rows.rationale: DTP-005 needed residuals for src/planning, src/implementation, src/graph, src/pi, src/git, and .codewiki target-state migration.
rows.expected_outcome: Planning/graph distinguish full, partial, implemented, active-roadmap, deferred, no-work, superseded, replanned, and unmapped states; partial coverage leaves blocking residuals.

rows.question: DPA-006-FILE-STRUCTURE-ACCOUNTABILITY

state_delta.current: file-structure-map accepted_target paths can remain info-only approved_migration_delta without roadmap coverage.
state_delta.desired: Accepted target paths and roots-to-retire need implementation evidence, active task/sprint, or structured deferral; otherwise they are actionable planning/gate findings.

rows.proposed_change: Accepted target paths and roots-to-retire need implementation evidence, active task/sprint, or structured deferral; otherwise they are actionable planning/gate findings.
rows.rationale: Missing target roots with no open roadmap refs include src/planning, src/implementation, src/graph, src/git, and src/pi.
rows.expected_outcome: Accepted target paths and roots-to-retire need implementation evidence, active task/sprint, or structured deferral; otherwise they are actionable planning/gate findings.

rows.question: DPA-007-TASK-ATOMICITY-CONTRACT

state_delta.current: Roadmap auto-reuse/refine can merge distinct row outcomes by shared specs/labels/paths.
state_delta.desired: Planning gate enforces atomic task boundaries and permits auto-reuse only when requirement ids and desired outcomes overlap.

rows.proposed_change: Planning gate enforces atomic task boundaries and permits auto-reuse only when requirement ids and desired outcomes overlap.
rows.rationale: Auto-reuse overmerged unrelated source-root work into TASK-107/TASK-109.
rows.expected_outcome: Planning gate enforces atomic task boundaries and permits auto-reuse only when requirement ids and desired outcomes overlap.

rows.question: DPA-008-PLANNING-EXECUTION-GRAPH

state_delta.current: Planning output lacks consistent runnable execution graph for parallel implementation work.
state_delta.desired: Planning trace includes work units, dependencies, waves, conflict scopes, lease plan, route-back triggers, roles, gates, and publisher serialization; generated graph projects it.

rows.proposed_change: Planning trace includes work units, dependencies, waves, conflict scopes, lease plan, route-back triggers, roles, gates, and publisher serialization; generated graph projects it.
rows.rationale: Accepted CW-FINAL-010 requires work partition, conflict matrix, waves, leases, route-backs, and publisher serialization.
rows.expected_outcome: Planning trace includes work units, dependencies, waves, conflict scopes, lease plan, route-back triggers, roles, gates, and publisher serialization; generated graph projects it.

rows.question: DPA-009-RUNTIME-WORKER-DISPATCH

state_delta.current: Worker spawning responsibility can be confused between planning, gateway, runtime, and agency.
state_delta.desired: Planning defines chunks; agency authorizes; runtime daemon dispatches workers through freshWorkerBridge and leases/worktrees; gates validate; publisher serializes.

rows.proposed_change: Planning defines chunks; agency authorizes; runtime daemon dispatches workers through freshWorkerBridge and leases/worktrees; gates validate; publisher serializes.
rows.rationale: Preserves responsibility split and prevents gates/planning from executing runtime orchestration.
rows.expected_outcome: Planning defines chunks; agency authorizes; runtime daemon dispatches workers through freshWorkerBridge and leases/worktrees; gates validate; publisher serializes.

rows.question: DPA-010-TEST-EVIDENCE-GATE-CONTRACT

state_delta.current: Tests live outside loop roots and current smoke/task/shared organization can obscure gate responsibility.
state_delta.desired: Tests remain evidence providers; loop gates define required tests/linters/content evidence; implementation traces record refs/results; implementation gate validates scope match.

rows.proposed_change: Tests remain evidence providers; loop gates define required tests/linters/content evidence; implementation traces record refs/results; implementation gate validates scope match.
rows.rationale: Gate findings should explain missing/weak evidence without requiring all tests to physically live inside gate roots.
rows.expected_outcome: Tests remain evidence providers; loop gates define required tests/linters/content evidence; implementation traces record refs/results; implementation gate validates scope match.

rows.question: DPA-011-PUBLICATION-UNDER-IMPLEMENTATION

state_delta.current: Task-close, ship-ready, publication, and release compatibility gates can look like separate loops or roots.
state_delta.desired: Publication remains inside implementation.publication and implementation gate criteria; no publish loop/folder unless future approved decision changes architecture.

rows.proposed_change: Publication remains inside implementation.publication and implementation gate criteria; no publish loop/folder unless future approved decision changes architecture.
rows.rationale: Accepted architecture says publication is not fourth loop and belongs under implementation by default.
rows.expected_outcome: Publication remains inside implementation.publication and implementation gate criteria; no publish loop/folder unless future approved decision changes architecture.

rows.question: DPA-012-REFACTOR-REPLAN-AFTER-GATE-FIXES

state_delta.current: Repo source target is not fully implemented but roadmap open=0 after TASK-107/108/109 closure.
state_delta.desired: After decision/planning/gate fixes are planned, create new refactor sprint for accepted target roots and roots-to-retire in atomic safe waves.

rows.proposed_change: After decision/planning/gate fixes are planned, create new refactor sprint for accepted target roots and roots-to-retire in atomic safe waves.
rows.rationale: Enforcement and planning safeguards should land before broad source moves so residual work is not lost again.
rows.expected_outcome: After decision/planning/gate fixes are planned, create new refactor sprint for accepted target roots and roots-to-retire in atomic safe waves.
